RW-GOV-01.name: Record keeping (10 years)
RW-GOV-01.description: Customer and transaction records are kept at least 10 years from the end of the business relationship. An older source says 5 years under the repealed 2023 law; the stricter figure is the default.
RW-GOV-01.action: Deny deletion before the period ends
RW-GOV-01.engineering_logic:
RULE RW-GOV-01 | type=control
WHEN  record.delete_requested
IF    record.age < tenant.cfg.rw_retention_years after relationship_end      # default 10y; 5y reading under Law 028/2023
THEN  deny_delete  reason=retention
RW-GOV-01.basis: [Regulatory]. Param of GOV-08. Default: On. Basis: RS2 (Art 21 per FUR); RS6 (5y conflict)

RW-GOV-02.name: No tipping off
RW-GOV-02.description: Nothing about an STR or suspicion flag appears in customer-facing screens, API responses, webhooks or exports. Reporters are protected from liability.
RW-GOV-02.engineering_logic:
RULE RW-GOV-02 | type=control
WHEN  api.response OR webhook.send OR export.generate
IF    payload CONTAINS (str.exists OR str.status OR flag.visibility = compliance_only)
AND   recipient.role NOT IN (compliance_officer, mlro)
THEN  strip_fields  AND  log=audit
RW-GOV-02.basis: [Regulatory]. Param of GOV-09. Default: On. Basis: RS3 (Art 34 per map)

RW-GOV-03.name: Approved reporting to the FIC
RW-GOV-03.description: Reports are prepared by the system and approved by a compliance officer before submission. FIC provides sector templates; no goAML use was found for Rwanda, so the channel is a tenant setting.
RW-GOV-03.engineering_logic:
RULE RW-GOV-03 | type=workflow
WHEN  report.draft_ready (STR, CTR, declaration)
IF    report.approved_by IN roles(compliance_officer)
THEN  allow_submit  via=tenant.cfg.fic_channel          # goAML not confirmed
ELSE  hold_for_approval
RW-GOV-03.basis: [Regulatory]. Param of GOV-06. Default: On. Basis: RS6 (no goAML evidence); FIC site

RW-GOV-04.name: Targeted financial sanctions workflow
RW-GOV-04.description: A designation starts a 24-hour freeze workflow with named owners, evidence and a log. Missing it costs RWF 1 million to RWF 10 million.
RW-GOV-04.engineering_logic:
RULE RW-GOV-04 | type=workflow
WHEN  designation.received
THEN  case=open  owner=mlro  timer=24h  steps=(screen, freeze, report_FIC, confirm)
IF    NOW > designation.received_at + 24h AND case.freeze_done = false THEN escalate=board  reason=tfs_deadline_breach
RW-GOV-04.basis: [Regulatory]. Param of GOV-05. Default: On. Basis: RS2, RS3

RW-GOV-05.name: Data protection registration, officer and impact assessment
RW-GOV-05.description: Register as controller or processor with the National Cyber Security Authority before processing; appoint a data protection officer where required; run impact assessments for high-risk processing; and list international transfers in the certificate.
RW-GOV-05.engineering_logic:
RULE RW-GOV-05 | type=job | schedule=daily
IF    tenant.ncsa_certificate IS NULL OR tenant.ncsa_certificate.expired = true  THEN readiness=fail reason=ncsa_registration
IF    tenant.dpo IS NULL AND tenant.cfg.rw_dpo_required = true                   THEN readiness=fail reason=dpo_missing
IF    processing.high_risk = true AND dpia.completed = false                     THEN readiness=fail reason=dpia_missing
IF    transfer.international.exists AND NOT ncsa_certificate.lists_transfer      THEN readiness=fail reason=transfer_not_listed
RW-GOV-05.basis: [Regulatory]. New local. Default: On. Basis: RS14 (Arts 29, 31, 40 per DLA Piper)

RW-GOV-06.name: Central bank cyber governance
RW-GOV-06.description: Board and senior management own cyber security; an IT board committee and a qualified IT security head exist; a written incident response plan is tested; staff training includes phishing simulations; a data retention and disposal policy exists.
RW-GOV-06.engineering_logic:
RULE RW-GOV-06 | type=policy
SCOPE tenant.bnr_regulated = true
IF    ANY OF ( board.cyber_owner IS NULL , it_security_head IS NULL , incident_response_plan.tested_last_12mo = false ,
               training.phishing_simulation_last_12mo = false , retention_disposal_policy IS NULL )
THEN  readiness=fail  reason=bnr_cyber_governance
RW-GOV-06.basis: [Regulatory]. New local. Default: On. Basis: RS17 (Arts 4, 5, 7, 17, 18, 20); RS18

RW-GOV-07.name: Virtual-asset provider licence record
RW-GOV-07.description: A virtual-asset tenant records its Capital Market Authority licence. Capital, deadlines and article numbers are not yet published, so the check ships off.
RW-GOV-07.engineering_logic:
RULE RW-GOV-07 | type=policy
WHEN  tenant.activate
SCOPE tenant.type = vasp AND tenant.cfg.rw_vasp_check_enabled = true
IF    tenant.cma_licence IS NULL
THEN  deny_activate  reason=missing_cma_licence      # disabled-by-default: implementing regulations pending
RW-GOV-07.basis: [Regulatory]. New local. Default: Off (threshold to be confirmed). Basis: RS13

RW-GOV-08.name: Sector risk ratings from the 2024 risk assessment
RW-GOV-08.description: Customers and counterparties carry a sector risk tag from the national risk assessment: real estate and bailiffs Medium-High; banks, e-money and forex bureaux Medium; remittance and virtual assets Medium-Low; lawyers and accountants Low. Tenants adjust them.
RW-GOV-08.engineering_logic:
RULE RW-GOV-08 | type=policy
WHEN  customer.onboarded OR customer.periodic_review
THEN  customer.sector_risk = tenant.cfg.rw_sector_risk[customer.sector]
      # default: real_estate MH, bailiffs MH, banking M, e_money M, forex M, remittance ML, vasp ML, legal_accounting L
RW-GOV-08.basis: [Industry practice]. New local. Default: On. Basis: RS25 (NRA 2024, Zigram summary)

RW-GOV-09.name: Internal service levels
RW-GOV-09.description: Triage a high-risk alert within 4 hours and reach an STR decision within 12 hours, so a 24-hour STR clock, whatever the final deadline, is never at risk.
RW-GOV-09.engineering_logic:
RULE RW-GOV-09 | type=sla
WHEN  alert.created
IF    alert.risk = high AND NOW - alert.created > 4h AND alert.triaged = false   THEN escalate
IF    alert.suspicion_recorded AND NOW - alert.suspicion_start_ts > 12h AND alert.str_decision IS NULL   THEN escalate
RW-GOV-09.basis: [My design]. Param of Nigeria recommended SLAs. Default: On. Basis: My design

RW-GOV-10.name: Retention conflicts between laws
RW-GOV-10.description: When the 10-year AML retention duty conflicts with a data-protection deletion request or the disposal policy, the longer legal duty wins and the reason is logged.
RW-GOV-10.engineering_logic:
RULE RW-GOV-10 | type=control
WHEN  deletion.requested
IF    record.under_legal_hold = true OR record.age < tenant.cfg.rw_retention_years after relationship_end
THEN  deny_delete  log=reason  notify=dpo      # design choice: confirm with Rwandan counsel
RW-GOV-10.basis: [My design]. New local. Default: On. Basis: RS2, RS14, RS17 (Art 17)

RW-REG-01.name: Cross-border cash declaration above US$10,000
RW-REG-01.description: Cash or bearer instruments above US$10,000 (or equivalent) brought into or out of Rwanda must be declared. A deposit of foreign cash above that amount with no declaration reference is flagged.
RW-REG-01.action: Hard: flag, open case, report to the FIC
RW-REG-01.engineering_logic:
RULE RW-REG-01 | control=hard | action=flag
WHEN  txn.type IN (cash.deposit, forex.buy, remittance.cash_in)
SCOPE txn.cash_source = cross_border
IF    txn.amount_usd_equiv > tenant.cfg.rw_declaration_threshold       # default USD 10_000; the regulation says amounts not exceeding USD 10_000 need no declaration
AND   declaration.reference IS NULL
THEN  flag=undeclared_cross_border_cash  case=open  task=report.FIC  reason=cross_border_cash
      # declarations reach the FIC within 2 days (Art 9); customs holds cash up to 2 hours (Art 7); those duties sit with the authority, not the tenant
RW-REG-01.basis: [Regulatory]. Analogue of REG-10 (physical cash, not wires). Default: On. Basis: RS5 (Reg 002/FIC/2021 Art 4, Art 9); verify still in force after Law 001/2025

RW-REG-02.name: Freeze within 24 hours
RW-REG-02.description: A person or entity subject to targeted financial sanctions has funds in the institution. 'Immediately' means within 24 hours at the latest, so the freeze clock starts when the designation is received.
RW-REG-02.engineering_logic:
RULE RW-REG-02 | control=hard | action=freeze
WHEN  designation.received OR list.updated
IF    ANY(customer, beneficial_owner, counterparty) MATCHES designation
THEN  freeze=account  deadline=designation.received_at + 24h  task=report.FIC  case=open
      reason=tfs_freeze  gov=RW-GOV-04
RW-REG-02.basis: [Regulatory]. Param of REG-11 (Rwanda defines the freeze clock). Default: On. Basis: RS3 (Art 2(b), Art 4); aggregator text

RW-REG-03.name: Sanctions and TFS screening
RW-REG-03.description: A name, ID or account matches UN or Rwandan targeted-sanctions lists, including spelling variants. Missing the duty carries a fine of RWF 1,000,000 to RWF 10,000,000.
RW-REG-03.action: Hard: block and open a freeze case
RW-REG-03.engineering_logic:
RULE RW-REG-03 | control=hard | action=block
WHEN  txn.created OR customer.onboarded OR list.updated
IF    screen(party.name, party.id, party.account) MATCHES lists(un_consolidated, rw_designations, tenant_lists)
        USING fuzzy + transliteration  score >= tenant.cfg.match_threshold
AND   match.reviewed = confirmed OR tenant.cfg.auto_block_on_strong_match = true
THEN  decision=block  case=open  trigger=RW-REG-02  reason=tfs_match
RW-REG-03.basis: [Regulatory]. Param of REG-11. Default: On. Basis: RS2 (FIC Reg 001/FIC/2025 Arts 26-27)

RW-REG-04.name: Suspicious transaction report (STR)
RW-REG-04.description: A person forms a suspicion that funds are linked to crime. The report goes to the FIC, without telling the customer. The numeric deadline in Law 001/2025 Art 32 was not found, so the clock is a tenant setting with a design default.
RW-REG-04.action: Report to the FIC; deadline is a placeholder
RW-REG-04.engineering_logic:
RULE RW-REG-04 | control=hard | action=report
WHEN  alert.suspicion_recorded OR alert.suspicion_confirmed
THEN  task=report.STR  due=tenant.cfg.rw_str_due        # PLACEHOLDER 24h from suspicion [My design]; statutory deadline not found: threshold to be confirmed
      to=FIC  gov=RW-GOV-02, RW-GOV-03
      # the duty is live; only the hour count is unconfirmed
RW-REG-04.basis: [Regulatory]. Param of REG-14 (deadline placeholder). Default: On. Basis: RS3 (Art 32, Art 34 per map); RS6

RW-REG-05.name: Cash and wire transaction report
RW-REG-05.description: Law 028/2023 Art 31 required reports of cash transactions and wire transfers; no amount was found in Law 001/2025 or FIC regulations. The rule ships off with a placeholder.
RW-REG-05.engineering_logic:
RULE RW-REG-05 | control=hard | action=report
WHEN  txn.type IN (cash.deposit, cash.withdrawal, cash.payment, transfer.wire)
SCOPE tenant.cfg.rw_ctr_enabled = true
IF    txn.amount >= tenant.cfg.rw_ctr_threshold       # PLACEHOLDER RWF 10_000_000 (from the brief, not found in any source); threshold to be confirmed; disabled-by-default
THEN  task=report.CTR  due=tenant.cfg.rw_ctr_due  to=FIC
RW-REG-05.basis: [Regulatory]. Analogue of REG-17 (amount not found). Default: Off (threshold to be confirmed). Basis: RS4 (predecessor Art 31); RS3

RW-REG-06.name: Politically exposed person (PEP)
RW-REG-06.description: The customer or an owner behind a company is a PEP. Senior management approves, source of wealth is verified, and monitoring is enhanced.
RW-REG-06.action: Hard: enhanced due diligence and senior approval
RW-REG-06.engineering_logic:
RULE RW-REG-06 | control=hard | action=edd
WHEN  customer.onboarded OR customer.periodic_review OR txn.created
IF    customer.is_pep = true OR ANY(beneficial_owner.is_pep = true)
THEN  decision=review  require=edd,source_of_funds,source_of_wealth,senior_approval  reason=pep
RW-REG-06.basis: [Regulatory]. Param of REG-12. Default: On. Basis: RS2 (R.12 now Compliant); RS3 (Art 22 per map)

RW-REG-07.name: eKash transaction cap and fee ceiling
RW-REG-07.description: A person-to-person transfer on the national eKash rail is above RWF 10 million, or the fee charged is above RWF 20. Institutions may set lower limits.
RW-REG-07.action: Hard: decline the transfer; block the over-limit fee
RW-REG-07.engineering_logic:
RULE RW-REG-07 | control=hard | action=decline
WHEN  txn.type = p2p.interoperable
SCOPE tenant.type IN (bank, emi, psp) AND txn.created_at >= 2026-07-14
IF    txn.amount > MIN(tenant.cfg.rw_ekash_cap, tenant.cfg.own_limit)      # default RWF 10_000_000
THEN  decision=decline  reason=ekash_cap
IF    txn.fee > tenant.cfg.rw_ekash_fee_max                               # default RWF 20
THEN  block_fee  reason=ekash_fee_ceiling
      # Directive text not seen; aggregator source only: verify before enabling for production
RW-REG-07.basis: [Regulatory]. New local. Default: On. Basis: RS12 (Directive 45/2026, secondary news)

RW-REG-08.name: Daily cash withdrawal ceiling (RWF 5 million)
RW-REG-08.description: A customer withdraws more than RWF 5 million in cash in a day through any payment instrument. Banks should pay by crossed cheque or credit transfer instead, and report exceptions to the central bank weekly. The 2009 directive may no longer apply.
RW-REG-08.action: Hard when enabled: decline cash; log exceptions
RW-REG-08.engineering_logic:
RULE RW-REG-08 | control=hard | action=decline
WHEN  txn.type = cash.withdrawal
SCOPE tenant.type = bank AND tenant.cfg.rw_cash_ceiling_enabled = true
WINDOW 1d BY customer.id
IF    SUM(txn.amount) + txn.amount > tenant.cfg.rw_cash_ceiling       # default RWF 5_000_000; verify; disabled-by-default
UNLESS exception.authorised_by_bank = true
THEN  decision=decline  route=credit_transfer
      IF exception.authorised_by_bank = true THEN add_to=weekly_bnr_exception_report
RW-REG-08.basis: [Regulatory]. Analogue of REG-07 and REG-09. Default: Off (verify first). Basis: RS9 (Directive 02/2009; verify currency)

RW-REG-09.name: Maximum three e-money accounts per customer
RW-REG-09.description: A customer opens a fourth e-money account without central bank authorisation. Whether the cap is per issuer or across issuers is not confirmed.
RW-REG-09.engineering_logic:
RULE RW-REG-09 | control=hard | action=decline
WHEN  wallet.open
SCOPE tenant.type = emi
IF    COUNT(wallet WHERE customer.nida_id = this AND issuer = tenant.id) >= tenant.cfg.rw_max_emoney_accounts      # default 3
AND   customer.bnr_authorisation IS NULL
THEN  decision=decline  reason=max_emoney_accounts       # scope per issuer is my reading of Art 9
RW-REG-09.basis: [Regulatory]. New local. Default: On. Basis: RS11 (Reg 54/2022 Art 9)

RW-REG-10.name: National ID verification, no anonymous accounts
RW-REG-10.description: An e-money account or wallet is opened without checking the national ID against the national database.
RW-REG-10.engineering_logic:
RULE RW-REG-10 | control=hard | action=block
WHEN  account.open OR wallet.open OR kyc.refresh
IF    identity.nida_verified != true OR customer.name IS NULL
THEN  decision=block  reason=nida_verification_missing
RW-REG-10.basis: [Regulatory]. Analogue of REG-06 (NIDA instead of BVN or NIN). Default: On. Basis: RS11 (Reg 54/2022 Art 9)

RW-REG-11.name: Authentication before e-money transactions
RW-REG-11.description: An e-money transaction is accepted without a PIN, password or other authentication step.
RW-REG-11.engineering_logic:
RULE RW-REG-11 | control=hard | action=decline
WHEN  txn.created
SCOPE tenant.type = emi AND txn.channel IN (mobile, ussd, web)
IF    txn.auth_method IS NULL
THEN  decision=decline  reason=no_customer_authentication
RW-REG-11.basis: [Regulatory]. Analogue of REG-03. Default: On. Basis: RS11 (Reg 54/2022 Art 10); BNR PDF

RW-REG-12.name: Beneficial owner identified for companies
RW-REG-12.description: A company customer is opened or reviewed without its beneficial owners being identified and verified. The ownership percentage that counts is not found, so the tenant sets it.
RW-REG-12.engineering_logic:
RULE RW-REG-12 | control=hard | action=review
WHEN  customer.onboarded OR customer.periodic_review
SCOPE customer.type = legal_person
IF    beneficial_owner.identified = false OR beneficial_owner.documents_complete = false
      # ownership share that defines a beneficial owner: tenant.cfg.rw_bo_pct, default NULL (not found): threshold to be confirmed
THEN  decision=review  restrict=new_products  reason=beneficial_owner_missing
RW-REG-12.basis: [Regulatory]. New local (Nigeria has KYB under GOV-01). Default: On. Basis: RS4 (Art 33 predecessor); RS32 (FIC Guidelines 001/2023)

RW-REG-13.name: Virtual-asset licensing gate
RW-REG-13.description: Virtual-asset business must go through a provider licensed by the Capital Market Authority. Virtual assets are not legal tender, and direct use as payment is barred unless the central bank allows it.
RW-REG-13.engineering_logic:
RULE RW-REG-13 | control=hard | action=review
WHEN  txn.created
IF    ( counterparty.type = virtual_asset_provider AND counterparty.cma_licensed != true )
   OR ( merchant.accepts_virtual_assets_as_payment = true AND merchant.bnr_authorisation IS NULL )
THEN  decision=review  hold=true  reason=unlicensed_virtual_asset_activity  link=CRY-03
      # licence register must be loaded by the tenant; article numbers of Law 023/2026 not found
RW-REG-13.basis: [Regulatory]. New local (cross-reference CRY rules). Default: On. Basis: RS13 (Law 023/2026)

RW-REG-14.name: Virtual-asset Travel Rule data
RW-REG-14.description: A virtual-asset transfer above the Travel Rule limit lacks sender or receiver details. Law 023/2026 refers to the rule, but no threshold was found, so the rule ships off.
RW-REG-14.engineering_logic:
RULE RW-REG-14 | control=hard | action=hold
WHEN  crypto.transfer
SCOPE tenant.type = vasp AND tenant.cfg.rw_travel_rule_enabled = true
IF    txn.amount_usd_equiv >= tenant.cfg.rw_travel_rule_min          # PLACEHOLDER NULL: threshold to be confirmed; disabled-by-default
AND   ANY OF ( originator.data_complete = false , beneficiary.data_complete = false )
THEN  decision=hold  link=CRY-13
RW-REG-14.basis: [Industry practice]. Cross-reference CRY-13 (threshold not found). Default: Off (threshold to be confirmed). Basis: RS13

RW-SEC-01.name: Penetration-test and vulnerability cadence
RW-SEC-01.description: Run an annual penetration test and vulnerability assessments twice a year, using certified testers, and send the executive summary to the central bank within 15 days after the test.
RW-SEC-01.engineering_logic:
RULE RW-SEC-01 | control=clock | action=task
SCOPE tenant.type IN (bank, mfi, insurer, emi, psp) AND tenant.bnr_regulated = true
WHEN  pentest.last_done > 12mo           THEN task=run.pentest
WHEN  vuln_assessment.last_done > 6mo    THEN task=run.vulnerability_assessment
WHEN  pentest.completed
IF    tester.certification NOT IN (CISSP, CISM, CISA, CEH, OSCP, LPT, equivalent) THEN flag=uncertified_tester
THEN  task=send.BNR_executive_summary  due=15d_after_test
RW-SEC-01.basis: [Regulatory]. New local. Default: On. Basis: RS17 (Reg 50/2022 Art 10)

RW-SEC-02.name: Multi-factor authentication for remote access
RW-SEC-02.description: Anyone reaching internal networks from outside must use multi-factor authentication, unless the IT security head approves an equivalent control in writing.
RW-SEC-02.engineering_logic:
RULE RW-SEC-02 | control=hard | action=block
WHEN  remote.access.login
SCOPE tenant.bnr_regulated = true
IF    session.mfa_passed = false
UNLESS compensating_control.approved_in_writing_by = it_security_head
THEN  decision=block  reason=mfa_required_remote_access
RW-SEC-02.basis: [Regulatory]. Analogue of REG-03. Default: On. Basis: RS17 (Art 16)

RW-SEC-03.name: Cyber incident report to the central bank
RW-SEC-03.description: A cyber incident must be reported to the central bank (Reg 50/2022 Art 21; Directive 4230/2024-00037). The hour count and severity test were not found, so the clock is a placeholder and the rule ships off.
RW-SEC-03.engineering_logic:
RULE RW-SEC-03 | control=clock | action=report
WHEN  incident.detected
SCOPE tenant.bnr_regulated = true
IF    incident.severity IN tenant.cfg.rw_bnr_reportable_levels      # PLACEHOLDER: severity test not found
THEN  task=report.BNR  due=tenant.cfg.rw_bnr_incident_clock         # PLACEHOLDER NULL: threshold to be confirmed; disabled-by-default; obtain from BNR supervisor
RW-SEC-03.basis: [Regulatory]. Param of Nigeria 24h CBN clock (value not found). Default: Off (threshold to be confirmed). Basis: RS17, RS18; hour count not found

RW-SEC-04.name: Personal-data breach notice within 48 hours
RW-SEC-04.description: A personal-data breach must reach the National Cyber Security Authority within 48 hours of awareness, and affected people are told when the risk is high.
RW-SEC-04.engineering_logic:
RULE RW-SEC-04 | control=clock | action=report
WHEN  breach.confirmed
IF    breach.personal_data = true
THEN  task=notify.NCSA  due=48h_from_awareness
IF    breach.high_risk = true
THEN  task=notify.data_subjects  due=tenant.cfg.rw_subject_notice      # default 48h (Hogan Lovells); DLA Piper gives no hour count
RW-SEC-04.basis: [Regulatory]. Param of Nigeria 72h NDPC clock (48h in Rwanda). Default: On. Basis: RS14 (Art 43, Art 45 per DLA Piper); ConsentStack

RW-SEC-05.name: Telecom incident reporting to RURA
RW-SEC-05.description: Critical and major incidents on telecom networks are reported to RURA immediately; moderate incidents are reported monthly. Mobile-money networks run on licensed telecom networks.
RW-SEC-05.engineering_logic:
RULE RW-SEC-05 | control=clock | action=report
WHEN  incident.detected
SCOPE tenant.type = telco OR tenant.rura_licensed = true
IF    incident.class IN (critical, major)  THEN task=report.RURA  due=immediate     # no hour count in the regulation
IF    incident.class = moderate            THEN task=report.RURA  due=monthly
RW-SEC-05.basis: [Regulatory]. New local (telecom tenants). Default: On. Basis: RS20 (Art 28)

RW-SEC-06.name: Telecom security audit and testing cadence
RW-SEC-06.description: Telecom licensees test annually, assess vulnerabilities twice a year, audit internally twice a year, fix deficiencies within 3 months and file reports within 30 days.
RW-SEC-06.engineering_logic:
RULE RW-SEC-06 | control=clock | action=task
SCOPE tenant.type = telco OR tenant.rura_licensed = true
WHEN  pentest.last_done > 12mo         THEN task=run.pentest
WHEN  vuln_assessment.last_done > 6mo  THEN task=run.vulnerability_assessment
WHEN  internal_audit.last_done > 6mo   THEN task=run.internal_audit
WHEN  audit.finding_opened             THEN task=remediate  due=3mo
WHEN  audit.completed                  THEN task=send.report_to_RURA  due=30d
RW-SEC-06.basis: [Regulatory]. New local (telecom tenants). Default: On. Basis: RS20 (Arts 20-24, 26)

RW-SEC-07.name: Data localisation and cross-border transfer authorisation
RW-SEC-07.description: Personal data is stored outside Rwanda, or sent abroad, without the registration certificate or authorisation the data protection law requires, or without a written contract.
RW-SEC-07.action: Flag and hold the transfer job
RW-SEC-07.engineering_logic:
RULE RW-SEC-07 | control=hard | action=flag
WHEN  data.transfer OR storage.region_changed
SCOPE data.class = personal AND destination.country != RW
IF    NOT ( ncsa.certificate.authorises_external_storage = true OR ncsa.transfer_authorisation.valid = true OR subject_consent.recorded = true )
OR    contract.written = false
THEN  flag=localisation_or_transfer  hold=transfer_job  reason=data_localisation
RW-SEC-07.basis: [Regulatory]. New local. Default: On. Basis: RS14 (Arts 48-50 per DLA Piper)

RW-SEC-08.name: Encryption in transit and at rest
RW-SEC-08.description: Customer data stores or links are found unencrypted.
RW-SEC-08.engineering_logic:
RULE RW-SEC-08 | control=hard | action=alert
WHEN  config.scan
SCOPE tenant.bnr_regulated = true
IF    ANY OF ( datastore.encrypted_at_rest = false , link.tls_enforced = false )
THEN  alert=encryption_gap  severity=high
RW-SEC-08.basis: [Regulatory]. New local. Default: On. Basis: RS17 (Art 19)

RW-SEC-09.name: Third-party and outsourcing assessments
RW-SEC-09.description: A service provider has no recorded due diligence, minimum security practices or periodic assessment.
RW-SEC-09.engineering_logic:
RULE RW-SEC-09 | control=policy | action=task
WHEN  vendor.onboard OR vendor.annual_review
SCOPE tenant.bnr_regulated = true
IF    vendor.due_diligence.done = false OR vendor.last_assessment > tenant.cfg.rw_vendor_cycle      # default 12mo
THEN  task=assess_vendor  readiness=fail
RW-SEC-09.basis: [Regulatory]. New local. Default: On. Basis: RS17 (Art 14); RS19 (Reg 74/2023 Art 44)

RW-SEC-10.name: Stolen-password testing (credential stuffing)
RW-SEC-10.description: Ten or more failed logins from one network address across five or more accounts in 5 minutes.
RW-SEC-10.engineering_logic:
RULE RW-SEC-10 | weight=30
WHEN  auth.failure
WINDOW 5m BY ip
IF    COUNT(auth.failure) >= 10 AND COUNT(DISTINCT account.id) >= 5
THEN  signal=RW-SEC-10  action_hint=rate_limit_ip
RW-SEC-10.basis: [Industry practice]. Param of SEC-01. Default: On. Basis: Nigeria library

RW-SEC-11.name: Approval-prompt flooding
RW-SEC-11.description: Five or more push or OTP prompts to one user in 10 minutes.
RW-SEC-11.engineering_logic:
RULE RW-SEC-11 | weight=25
WHEN  mfa.prompt_sent
WINDOW 10m BY account.id
IF    COUNT(mfa.prompt_sent WHERE type IN (push, otp)) >= 5
THEN  signal=RW-SEC-11  action_hint=pause_prompts
RW-SEC-11.basis: [Industry practice]. Param of SEC-04. Default: On. Basis: Nigeria library

RW-SEC-12.name: API key misuse
RW-SEC-12.description: A key is used from a new network or country, at five times its normal rate, or with many failed requests.
RW-SEC-12.engineering_logic:
RULE RW-SEC-12 | weight=30
WHEN  api.request
SCOPE auth.type = api_key
IF    ANY OF ( request.network NOT IN key.known_networks , request.country NOT IN key.known_countries ,
               RATE(request OVER 5m) > 5 * key.baseline_rate , RATIO(status IN (400, 404) OVER 10m) > tenant.cfg.probe_ratio )
THEN  signal=RW-SEC-12  action_hint=throttle_key
RW-SEC-12.basis: [Industry practice]. Param of SEC-08. Default: On. Basis: Nigeria library

RW-SEC-13.name: Rights raised, then data exported
RW-SEC-13.description: A user's role is upgraded and they export data within the hour.
RW-SEC-13.engineering_logic:
RULE RW-SEC-13 | weight=30
WHEN  data.export
WINDOW 1h BY user.id
IF    EXISTS(user.role_changed)
THEN  signal=RW-SEC-13
RW-SEC-13.basis: [Industry practice]. Param of SEC-10. Default: On. Basis: Nigeria library

RW-SEC-14.name: Unusually large export
RW-SEC-14.description: An export far above the user's or institution's normal size; a possible personal-data breach that starts the 48-hour clock in RW-SEC-04 once confirmed.
RW-SEC-14.engineering_logic:
RULE RW-SEC-14 | weight=25
WHEN  data.export
IF    export.rows > 5 * BASELINE(export.rows BY user.id OVER 30d)
   OR export.rows > 5 * BASELINE(export.rows BY tenant.id OVER 30d)
THEN  signal=RW-SEC-14  link=RW-SEC-04
RW-SEC-14.basis: [Industry practice]. Param of SEC-12. Default: On. Basis: Nigeria library; RS14

RW-SEC-15.name: Evidence preservation after illegal computer use
RW-SEC-15.description: A service provider that sees illegal use of a computer system reports it to the cybersecurity authority immediately and preserves the evidence.
RW-SEC-15.engineering_logic:
RULE RW-SEC-15 | control=clock | action=report
WHEN  incident.classified = illegal_computer_use
THEN  task=report.NCSA  due=immediate  preserve=logs,evidence  retention=case_closed_plus(tenant.cfg.evidence_hold)
RW-SEC-15.basis: [Regulatory]. New local. Default: On. Basis: RS15 (Law 60/2018 Arts 5-6, per summary)

RW-SEC-16.name: Illegal SIM-swap incident report (draft rule)
RW-SEC-16.description: A telecom operator finds an illegal SIM swap and must report it within 48 hours under a draft RURA regulation. The draft's RWF 10 million swap fine is also unconfirmed.
RW-SEC-16.engineering_logic:
RULE RW-SEC-16 | control=clock | action=report
WHEN  incident.classified = illegal_sim_swap
SCOPE tenant.type = telco AND tenant.cfg.rw_sim_draft_enabled = true
THEN  task=report.RURA  due=48h      # draft only: disabled-by-default until a final regulation is confirmed
RW-SEC-16.basis: [Regulatory]. New local (telecom tenants). Default: Off (verify first). Basis: RS21 (draft, January 2023)

RW-TM-01.name: New account, big volume
RW-TM-01.description: An account or wallet under 7 days old moves far more than normal. Survey data put 7.7% of fraud at account creation versus 1.6% at login and 0.5% at transactions.
RW-TM-01.engineering_logic:
RULE RW-TM-01 | weight=20
WHEN  txn.created
SCOPE account.age < 7d
IF    SUM(txn.amount OVER account.age) > 10 * kyc_tier.norm(account.kyc_tier)
THEN  signal=RW-TM-01  evidence=(volume, tier_norm)
RW-TM-01.basis: [Industry practice]. Param of MUL-04 (limits are issuer-defined, so tier norm is a tenant value). Default: On. Basis: RS23

RW-TM-02.name: SIM replacement, then transaction
RW-TM-02.description: A SIM replacement or re-registration, then a login, one-time password or transaction within a configurable number of hours. No legal cooling-off period was found.
RW-TM-02.engineering_logic:
RULE RW-TM-02 | weight=25 | action=step_up
WHEN  txn.type IN (transfer.outbound, wallet.send, wallet.cash_out) OR otp.requested
IF    ANY OF ( telco.sim_swap_flag = true , EXISTS(sim.replaced OVER tenant.cfg.rw_sim_swap_window) )     # default 72h; not a legal clock
AND   txn.amount > tenant.cfg.floor                    # suggested RWF 200_000 (analyst judgement)
THEN  signal=RW-TM-02  evidence=(swap_time, channel)
RW-TM-02.basis: [Industry practice]. Param of ATO-03 (window is a tenant value). Default: On. Basis: RS21, RS23

RW-TM-03.name: Repeated SIM changes on one national ID
RW-TM-03.description: The same national ID shows two or more SIM registrations or replacements in 30 days. A draft RURA rule caps SIMs at three per operator for Rwandan ID holders; the cap is unconfirmed.
RW-TM-03.engineering_logic:
RULE RW-TM-03 | weight=15
WHEN  sim.registered OR sim.replaced
WINDOW 30d BY nida_id
IF    COUNT(sim.registered OR sim.replaced) >= 2
OR    COUNT(DISTINCT msisdn WHERE operator = same) > tenant.cfg.rw_sims_per_mno     # default 3 (draft only); disabled-by-default part
THEN  signal=RW-TM-03
RW-TM-03.basis: [Industry practice]. Param of SIM-02 (draft cap on SIMs per ID). Default: On. Basis: RS21 (draft)

RW-TM-04.name: SIM not verified or foreign-linked, large load
RW-TM-04.description: A large value is loaded onto a SIM or wallet whose SIM is not verified against the national ID, or is linked to a foreign number. The March 2026 Equity Bank Rwanda case used such SIMs.
RW-TM-04.engineering_logic:
RULE RW-TM-04 | weight=20 | action=review
WHEN  txn.type IN (wallet.credit, transfer.inbound)
IF    ANY OF ( identity.sim_nida_verified = false , msisdn.country != RW )
AND   txn.amount > tenant.cfg.high_value             # suggested RWF 1_000_000
THEN  signal=RW-TM-04
RW-TM-04.basis: [Industry practice]. Param of SIM-01 (national ID instead of NIN). Default: On. Basis: RS24, RS21

RW-TM-05.name: New device, new payee, then transfer
RW-TM-05.description: Within 30 minutes: a new device is linked, a new payee is added, and money is sent above the minimum.
RW-TM-05.engineering_logic:
RULE RW-TM-05 | weight=30 | action=review
WHEN  txn.type IN (transfer.outbound, wallet.send)
WINDOW 30m BY account.id
IF    EXISTS(device.bound WHERE device.is_new = true)
AND   EXISTS(beneficiary.added WHERE beneficiary.is_new = true)
AND   txn.amount > tenant.cfg.floor
THEN  signal=RW-TM-05  evidence=(device.id, beneficiary.id, times)
RW-TM-05.basis: [Industry practice]. Param of ATO-01. Default: On. Basis: RS23 (account takeover 24% of losses)

RW-TM-06.name: Credentials changed, then transfer
RW-TM-06.description: Password, PIN, phone or email changed in the last 24 hours, then money is sent above the minimum.
RW-TM-06.engineering_logic:
RULE RW-TM-06 | weight=25 | action=step_up
WHEN  txn.type IN (transfer.outbound, wallet.send)
IF    ANY OF ( EXISTS(profile.password_changed OVER 24h) , EXISTS(profile.pin_changed OVER 24h) ,
               EXISTS(profile.phone_changed OVER 24h) , EXISTS(profile.email_changed OVER 24h) )
AND   txn.amount > tenant.cfg.floor
THEN  signal=RW-TM-06
RW-TM-06.basis: [Industry practice]. Param of ATO-02. Default: On. Basis: RS23

RW-TM-07.name: Money passing straight through (mule)
RW-TM-07.description: 80% or more of money received leaves within 60 minutes. Mule scams were the largest loss category (29%) in the survey sample.
RW-TM-07.engineering_logic:
RULE RW-TM-07 | weight=25 | action=review
WHEN  txn.type IN (transfer.outbound, wallet.send)
WINDOW 60m BY account.id
IF    SUM(txn.amount WHERE direction=out) >= 0.80 * SUM(txn.amount WHERE direction=in)
AND   SUM(txn.amount WHERE direction=in) > tenant.cfg.floor
THEN  signal=RW-TM-07  evidence=(in_sum, out_sum, ratio)
RW-TM-07.basis: [Industry practice]. Param of MUL-01. Default: On. Basis: RS23, RS25

RW-TM-08.name: Many senders into one account
RW-TM-08.description: Ten or more different senders pay one account in 24 hours.
RW-TM-08.engineering_logic:
RULE RW-TM-08 | weight=20
WHEN  txn.type = transfer.inbound
WINDOW 24h BY account.id
IF    COUNT(DISTINCT sender.id) >= 10
THEN  signal=RW-TM-08
RW-TM-08.basis: [Industry practice]. Param of MUL-02. Default: On. Basis: RS23

RW-TM-09.name: One payment split many ways
RW-TM-09.description: One incoming payment is split among five or more recipients within 60 minutes.
RW-TM-09.engineering_logic:
RULE RW-TM-09 | weight=20
WHEN  txn.type IN (transfer.outbound, wallet.send)
WINDOW 60m BY source_inflow.id
IF    COUNT(DISTINCT beneficiary.id) >= 5
THEN  signal=RW-TM-09
RW-TM-09.basis: [Industry practice]. Param of MUL-03. Default: On. Basis: RS23

RW-TM-10.name: Dormant account wakes up
RW-TM-10.description: No activity for 90 days or more, then a large payment in or out. The 2024 risk assessment lists dormant-account reactivation as an indicator.
RW-TM-10.engineering_logic:
RULE RW-TM-10 | weight=20
WHEN  txn.created
IF    account.days_since_last_activity >= 90
AND   txn.amount > tenant.cfg.large_after_dormancy     # suggested RWF 1_000_000
THEN  signal=RW-TM-10
RW-TM-10.basis: [Industry practice]. Param of MUL-05. Default: On. Basis: RS25 (NRA indicator)

RW-TM-11.name: Shared national ID, phone or device across accounts
RW-TM-11.description: One device is used on three or more accounts, or one national ID, phone number or address appears on several accounts or applications.
RW-TM-11.engineering_logic:
RULE RW-TM-11 | weight=25 | action=review
WHEN  account.created OR application.submitted OR txn.created
IF    ANY OF ( COUNT(DISTINCT account.id BY device.id) >= 3 ,
               COUNT(DISTINCT account.id BY nida_id WHERE issuer = tenant.id) > tenant.cfg.rw_max_emoney_accounts ,
               COUNT(DISTINCT account.id BY phone) >= 2 , COUNT(DISTINCT account.id BY address) >= 2 )
THEN  signal=RW-TM-11  evidence=(shared_identifier, linked_accounts)
RW-TM-11.basis: [Industry practice]. Param of MUL-06 (national ID added). Default: On. Basis: RS23, RS24

RW-TM-12.name: Splitting to stay under ceilings
RW-TM-12.description: Three or more transactions in 24 hours each between 90% and 99.9% of a known limit: the RWF 5 million cash ceiling, the RWF 10 million eKash cap, or the institution's own limit. The 2024 risk assessment lists structured withdrawals.
RW-TM-12.engineering_logic:
RULE RW-TM-12 | weight=25 | action=review
WHEN  txn.created
WINDOW 24h BY account.id
IF    COUNT(txn WHERE txn.amount BETWEEN 0.90*L AND 0.999*L) >= 3
      WHERE L IN ( tenant.cfg.rw_cash_ceiling , tenant.cfg.rw_ekash_cap , tenant.cfg.own_limit )
THEN  signal=RW-TM-12  evidence=(limit_hit, amounts)
RW-TM-12.basis: [Industry practice]. Param of VEL-04. Default: On. Basis: RS25, RS12, RS9

RW-TM-13.name: Large first payment to a new payee
RW-TM-13.description: A first large payment to a new payee, or cumulative payments of RWF 1 million to new payees in 24 hours. The median survey loss was RWF 869,249; the band is analyst judgement.
RW-TM-13.engineering_logic:
RULE RW-TM-13 | weight=20
WHEN  txn.type IN (transfer.outbound, wallet.send)
WINDOW 24h BY account.id
IF    SUM(txn.amount WHERE beneficiary.is_new = true) >= tenant.cfg.rw_new_payee_cum      # default RWF 1_000_000 (suggested band RWF 500_000 to 1_000_000)
THEN  signal=RW-TM-13
RW-TM-13.basis: [My design]. New local. Default: On. Basis: RS23 (median loss); band is my design

RW-TM-14.name: Sudden spike against the customer's own pattern
RW-TM-14.description: Money sent in 24 hours is more than three times the usual daily amount, or a single amount is far above the customer's history.
RW-TM-14.engineering_logic:
RULE RW-TM-14 | weight=20
WHEN  txn.type IN (transfer.outbound, wallet.send)
WINDOW 24h BY account.id
IF    SUM(txn.amount) > 3 * AVG(daily_outbound OVER 30d)
AND   SUM(txn.amount) > tenant.cfg.floor
THEN  signal=RW-TM-14
IF    txn.amount > AVG(txn.amount OVER 90d) + 3 * STDDEV(txn.amount OVER 90d) AND customer.history_days >= 30
THEN  signal=RW-TM-14 weight=24
RW-TM-14.basis: [Industry practice]. Param of VEL-02 and BEH-01. Default: On. Basis: Nigeria library

RW-TM-15.name: Impossible travel or foreign location
RW-TM-15.description: A country the customer does not normally use (10 points), or two events too far apart to travel between in the time (20 points).
RW-TM-15.engineering_logic:
RULE RW-TM-15 | weight=10 or 20
WHEN  session.login OR txn.created
IF    geo.country NOT IN profile.usual_countries THEN signal=RW-TM-15 weight=10
IF    distance(geo, previous.geo) / time_between > 900 km/h THEN signal=RW-TM-15 weight=20
RW-TM-15.basis: [Industry practice]. Param of BEH-02. Default: On. Basis: Nigeria library

RW-TM-16.name: Agent cash-out clustering and float manipulation
RW-TM-16.description: Several customers cash out at one agent in a short span, or an agent's float moves in ways its customers do not explain. The Equity Bank Rwanda case (about USD 3.4m) exploited float mechanisms. All numbers are placeholders.
RW-TM-16.engineering_logic:
RULE RW-TM-16 | weight=25 | action=review
WHEN  agent.daily_job OR txn.type = wallet.cash_out
SCOPE agent.active = true
WINDOW 60m BY agent.id
IF    COUNT(DISTINCT customer.id WHERE txn.type = wallet.cash_out) >= tenant.cfg.rw_agent_cluster_min
OR    agent.float_topup_24h > tenant.cfg.float_peer_mult * peer_group.p95(float_topup_24h)
      # PLACEHOLDER values: threshold to be confirmed; disabled-by-default
THEN  signal=RW-TM-16  visibility=compliance_only
RW-TM-16.basis: [My design]. New local. Default: Off (threshold to be confirmed). Basis: RS24 (single case); no float threshold found

RW-TM-17.name: Remittance in, then many small cash-outs
RW-TM-17.description: An international remittance arrives and is withdrawn in many small cash-outs at several agents. A national risk assessment case paid agents RWF 20,000 per withdrawal.
RW-TM-17.engineering_logic:
RULE RW-TM-17 | weight=25 | action=review
WHEN  txn.type = wallet.cash_out
WINDOW 72h BY account.id
IF    EXISTS(inflow WHERE inflow.type = remittance.international.in AND inflow.amount >= tenant.cfg.floor)
AND   COUNT(DISTINCT agent.id) >= 3
AND   SUM(txn.amount) >= 0.70 * inflow.amount
THEN  signal=RW-TM-17
RW-TM-17.basis: [Industry practice]. New local. Default: On. Basis: RS25 (NRA case)

RW-TM-18.name: Real-estate payments
RW-TM-18.description: A large payment to a property seller or developer is funded by cash, many small deposits or a recently opened account whose income does not explain it. Real estate is rated Medium-High, the highest sector, in the 2024 risk assessment.
RW-TM-18.engineering_logic:
RULE RW-TM-18 | weight=25 | action=review
WHEN  txn.type IN (transfer.outbound, cheque.issue)
SCOPE counterparty.sector = real_estate OR memo MATCHES (plot, land, house, property, developer)
IF    txn.amount >= tenant.cfg.rw_realestate_floor                 # PLACEHOLDER NULL: threshold to be confirmed; disabled-by-default
AND   ANY OF ( funding.cash_share_30d >= 0.50 , account.age < 90d , txn.amount > 5 * customer.declared_monthly_income )
THEN  signal=RW-TM-18  require=source_of_funds
RW-TM-18.basis: [Industry practice]. New local. Default: Off (threshold to be confirmed). Basis: RS25 (NRA); thresholds not found

RW-TM-19.name: Shell company pattern
RW-TM-19.description: A company with no visible business activity, a shared address or director, thin ownership detail and fast pass-through of funds. A crypto scam case moved USD 3.4m through 48 shell companies.
RW-TM-19.engineering_logic:
RULE RW-TM-19 | weight=30 | action=review
WHEN  txn.created
SCOPE customer.type = legal_person
IF    COUNT(shell_indicators WHERE ind IN (no_employees, shared_address, shared_director, no_website, beneficial_owner_unclear, high_pass_through)) >= 3
THEN  signal=RW-TM-19  evidence=(indicators)
RW-TM-19.basis: [Industry practice]. New local. Default: On. Basis: RS25 (NRA, KT Press)

RW-TM-20.name: Insider embezzlement
RW-TM-20.description: Staff-linked accounts move far more than peers, manual overrides run high, or staff touch a customer's details just before money leaves. Embezzlement is 39% of proceeds in the 2024 risk assessment.
RW-TM-20.engineering_logic:
RULE RW-TM-20 | weight=20 or 30 | action=review
WHEN  txn.created
SCOPE account.linked_to_employee = true OR staff_action.exists
IF    SUM(txn.amount OVER 30d) > peer_group.p95(SUM OVER 30d)                       THEN signal=RW-TM-20 weight=20
IF    EXISTS(staff_action WHERE type IN (view_contact, change_contact, change_limits) OVER 24h) AND txn.type = transfer.outbound
                                                                                    THEN signal=RW-TM-20 weight=30
      visibility=compliance_only
RW-TM-20.basis: [Industry practice]. Param of INS-01 and INS-02. Default: On. Basis: RS25

RW-TM-21.name: Pyramid and Ponzi-style pooling
RW-TM-21.description: Twenty or more unrelated senders pay one account in 7 days and 30% or more of payouts go to earlier payers. The central bank has warned about pyramid schemes and scam coins since 2019.
RW-TM-21.engineering_logic:
RULE RW-TM-21 | weight=25 | action=review
WHEN  txn.type = transfer.inbound
WINDOW 7d BY account.id
IF    COUNT(DISTINCT sender.id WHERE unrelated = true) >= 20
AND   SUM(outflow WHERE recipient IN prior_senders) >= 0.30 * SUM(outflow)
THEN  signal=RW-TM-21
RW-TM-21.basis: [Industry practice]. Param of PON-01. Default: On. Basis: RS29

RW-TM-22.name: Crypto exposure under Law 023/2026
RW-TM-22.description: Many small credits followed by payments to exchanges or unlicensed virtual-asset counterparties. Cross-reference CRY-01, CRY-03 and CRY-08 for the on-chain rules.
RW-TM-22.engineering_logic:
RULE RW-TM-22 | weight=25 | action=review
WHEN  txn.type IN (transfer.outbound, wallet.send)
WINDOW 7d BY account.id
IF    COUNT(DISTINCT sender.id) >= 10
AND   SUM(txn.amount WHERE counterparty.tag IN (vasp, p2p_crypto, unlicensed_vasp)) >= 0.70 * SUM(txn.amount WHERE direction=in)
THEN  signal=RW-TM-22  link=CRY-01,CRY-03,CRY-08
RW-TM-22.basis: [My design]. New local (cross-reference CRY-01, CRY-03, CRY-08). Default: On. Basis: RS13, RS25

RW-TM-23.name: Foreign cash split to stay under the declaration line
RW-TM-23.description: Two or more foreign-cash deposits in 7 days, each between 90% and 99.9% of US$10,000.
RW-TM-23.engineering_logic:
RULE RW-TM-23 | weight=25 | action=review
WHEN  txn.type IN (cash.deposit, forex.buy)
SCOPE txn.cash_source = cross_border
WINDOW 7d BY customer.id
IF    COUNT(txn WHERE txn.amount_usd_equiv BETWEEN 0.90*tenant.cfg.rw_declaration_threshold AND 0.999*tenant.cfg.rw_declaration_threshold) >= 2
THEN  signal=RW-TM-23
RW-TM-23.basis: [My design]. New local (derived from the declaration limit). Default: On. Basis: RS5; derivation is my design

RW-TM-24.name: SIM-box and bulk SIM pattern (telecom tenants)
RW-TM-24.description: A device or account uses 30 or more SIMs, or shows international call patterns that bypass legitimate routes. A 2017 SIM-box case cost RWF 1 billion.
RW-TM-24.engineering_logic:
RULE RW-TM-24 | weight=20 | action=review
WHEN  cdr.daily_job
SCOPE tenant.type = telco
IF    COUNT(DISTINCT sim.id BY device.imei OR gateway.id) >= tenant.cfg.rw_simbox_sims        # default 30
OR    international_inbound_terminating_as_local_ratio > tenant.cfg.simbox_ratio
THEN  signal=RW-TM-24
RW-TM-24.basis: [Industry practice]. New local (telecom tenants only). Default: On. Basis: RS28
